textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.EYI_Opportunity_Name__c} We are glad to inform you that the construction of your Unit {!$Record.EYI_Inventory__r.Name} Project {!$Record.EYI_Project_Enquired__r.Name} situated at {!$Record.EYI_Residence_address__Street__s} is complete and we have received Completion Certificate from the Corporation/Concerned Authority along with Occupancy Certificate for the said Unit. We are also annexing Architect Certificate in Form 4 prescribed by RERA. We, therefore, call upon you to take Possession of your Unit within 15 days of receipt of this communication. You are also requested to pay 5% of Consideration value as per the agreed terms in Agreement for Sale, which are payable on completion/ taking possession of the Unit. It is pertinent that you have to pay advance maintenance charges equivalent to 2 years maintenance charges {!$Record.SyncedQuote.Maintenance_Charges__c} and amount of Rs {!$Record.SyncedQuote.EYI_Agreement_Value__c} towards contribution to Corpus Fund
For any further information kindly contact Regards, CRM Team.
